profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Expert in Backend Development, API Design & Cloud Solutions | Proven Project Leader
profile.summary:
🚀 Building Scalable Systems | API Specialist | Cloud-Enthusiast
I’m a Senior Software Engineer at AT&T with experience in backend development, API design, and cloud technologies. My passion? Building high-performance, scalable applications that solve complex problems efficiently.

💡 From Code to Cloud:
I specialize in Java, C/C++, Python, and JavaScript, architecting robust APIs and backend services that power modern applications. Whether it’s designing RESTful APIs with Spring Boot & MuleSoft, optimizing database performance, or deploying cloud-native microservices, I ensure systems run smoothly, securely, and at scale.

🛠 What I Do Best:
🔹 Backend Engineering – Writing clean, efficient, and scalable code in Java & Python, focusing on performance and maintainability.
🔹 API Development & Integration – Crafting high-performing REST APIs and seamlessly integrating backend services.
🔹 Cloud & DevOps – Deploying cloud-native apps on AWS & Azure, leveraging Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for seamless automation.
🔹 Database Optimization – Designing efficient schemas, tuning queries, and improving performance in PostgreSQL & MySQL.
🔹 Scalability & Performance – Led initiatives to improve system efficiency, ensuring applications handle high traffic with ease.

🚀 Innovation Meets Impact
I don’t just develop software—I engineer solutions that make a tangible impact. Whether it’s improving deployment efficiency or optimizing backend systems for millions of users, I thrive on solving tough challenges through innovation and technical excellence.

💬 Always excited to connect, collaborate, and code! If you’re working on something exciting in backend engineering, cloud, or API development, let’s talk! 🔗
